UPSRTC Bus Conductor Online Form 2026 (43 Posts) - Complete Details

UPSRTC Bus Conductor Online Form 2026 (43 Posts). Eligible candidates can apply online through the official website before the last date. The last date to apply is 02 July 2026. Check important dates, application fee, eligibility criteria and official links below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start : 24 June 2026
  • Last Date for Apply : 02 July 2026
  • Interview Date : District Wise

Application Fee

  • No Application Fee

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
